name: Shards of the Banished
description:
About This Game

Overview:
Shards of the Banished is a soulslike action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic dark fantasy world. You play as a lone warrior cast into a land consumed by glimmering darkness and the ashes of what was once a prosperous realm. Survive brutal encounters, explore ruined landscapes, and harness the mysterious power of crystals to uncover the truth behind your banishment.

Key Features:

  • Deep Combat System: Master a stamina-based melee combat system with dodge rolls, parries, and powerful finishers.

  • Character Progression: Unlock new abilities through a detailed skill tree tailored to your combat style.

  • Talismans: Collect and equip a variety of talismans that grant passive bonuses, stat boosts, and special effects.

  • Boss Fights: Face off against 3 deadly bosses, each with unique mechanics and challenges.

  • World Design: Navigate interconnected areas filled with secrets, traps, shortcuts, and hidden lore.

  • Replayability: Multiple builds and playstyles encourage experimentation and repeated playthroughs.

  • Atmospheric World: Experience a haunting soundtrack and environmental storytelling that deepen the immersion.
short_desc: Shards of the Banished is a dark fantasy action-RPG set in a cursed medieval world. A fallen king, a cursed queen, and a power-hungry usurper have plunged the land into ruin. As the exiled heir, you must rise, face powerful foes, and reclaim what is rightfully yours.
